item.title: Toolstation unveils new store format
item.description: Toolstation has launched a new store format called Toolstation Go, designed to offer a “faster, more convenient way to shop”.

item.title: Boots Group CEO steps down to become chair
item.description: Boots chief executive Ornella Barra has stepped down from her executive role to become chair, in a senior leadership reshuffle that could open the door to the UK retailer being separated from its parent company.

item.title: Screwfix hails 1,000 store milestone
item.description: Screwfix has hit 1,000 stores across the UK, Ireland and France.

item.title: Aldi to launch 500 apprenticeship roles in 2026
item.description: Aldi has opened applications for 500 apprenticeship roles, with positions available in stores and warehouses across the UK.

item.title: Over 50% of households worse off than a year ago, Asda income tracker reports
item.description: Nearly six in ten households feel their weekly salaries don't stretch as far as they did a year ago, the latest figures from Asda’s income tracker have found.

item.title: Aldi unveils £370m investment plan
item.description: Aldi is set to invest £370m to open 40 new stores, as part of its two-year expansion programme.
